caption:
Figure 2. Approach Overview. We first pre-train a reconstruction model using multi-view renderings of synthetic data. We then self-train
category-specific models on diverse image collections in-the-wild with only foreground mask annotations. We finally distill the learned
models from prior training stages into a unified reconstruction model.
delegated_acceptance_review: Actually viewed final three-stage reconstruction overview, read source caption and generic-prior/category-adaptation discussion and all independent checks. Synthetic multi-view pairs, three in-the-wild categories, gray/purple/orange/yellow prior models and blue unified model remain intact. Original stage order and arrows are preserved, including original typo form. Added callouts explain synthetic supervision, mask-based category adaptation and distillation from both preceding stages directly as source describes, with no new model or output.
